Title: Modding — Mod manager, manifest spec, packaging, registry

Summary
Provide official mod support: manifest schema, packaging rules, mod manager UI, registry distribution model, version resolution, sandboxing, and tooling (SDK/CLI) so community mods can be safely discovered, installed, and managed.

Why
Enables community-driven content, extends game longevity, and provides a defined surface for mod creators and pipelines.

Files
- docs/plans/4x-game/game-operations/modding.md
- docs/plans/4x-game/game-operations/modding/manifest-spec.md

Acceptance criteria
- Modding feature plan reviewed and approved.
- Manifest spec finalized (fields, versioning, dependencies, integrity).
- Packaging format & install/uninstall behaviour defined.
- MVP mod manager UI wireframe + basic install/uninstall flow documented.
- Security/sandboxing guidance drafted.
- Deliverables and tests listed in the feature plan are present.

Suggested labels: feature, area:modding, needs-triage
Suggested assignee: @JohnLudlow

Notes
Please review the two docs above and update the issue with any blockers or missing deliverables.
